    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FGModuleCat.exists_simple_quotient {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {X : FGModuleCat R} (hX : ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero X) :

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FGModuleCat.fitting_nilpotent_or_isIso {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] {X : FGModuleCat R} (hX : CategoryTheory.Indecomposable X) (f : X ⟶ X) :

    By Fitting decomposition, an endomorphism of an indecomposable finite module over an Artinian ring is nilpotent or invertible.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FGModuleCat.isIso_of_quotient_eq_self {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] {X Y : FGModuleCat R} (hX : CategoryTheory.Indecomposable X) (p : X ⟶ Y) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : X ⟶ X) (ha : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a p = p) :
    CategoryTheory.IsIso a

    An endomorphism acting as the identity on a nonzero quotient of an indecomposable module is invertible.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FGModuleCat.nonempty_iso_of_common_quotient {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] {P Q S : FGModuleCat R} [Module.Projective R ↑P] [Module.Projective R ↑Q] (hP : CategoryTheory.Indecomposable P) (hQ : CategoryTheory.Indecomposable Q) (p : P ⟶ S) (q : Q ⟶ S) [CategoryTheory.Epi p] [CategoryTheory.Epi q] (hS : ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero S) :
    Nonempty (P ≅ Q)

    Indecomposable projectives admitting the same simple quotient are isomorphic. The argument uses the two lifts of the quotient maps.
